submission.natural_language_explanation: Broad early head that is weakly active on much ordinary prose: from the verb, auxiliary, possessive 's, or predicate particle (not/out) that follows a full-noun-phrase subject, it attends back to that subject's head noun, skipping any intervening auxiliary or verb and spanning long distances, and peaks strongest there. With a pronoun subject, a one- or two-word text, or a run of bare numbers or symbols it stays near or below the active line.
